title: Implement IRC to LICHEN relay: listen on IRC channels, POST to /msg/inbox with sender identity
description: Implement the IRC-to-LICHEN direction of the bridge. Listen for messages on configured IRC channels. Check sender authorization against configured nick/hostmask allowlist. Convert authorized IRC messages into LICHEN /msg/inbox POST requests targeting the mapped group/realm. Include sender identity metadata without impersonating arbitrary IRC accounts. Apply message length limits and attachment handling policy. Reject unauthorized users, malformed content, oversized messages, and protocol-control attempts. Implement store-and-forward for LoRa outages.
